label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified

scope.covers: the normal human-player shop path: no special game rule, no shop-modifying item or synergy effect, shared pools of a standard game, player level 2..9 (the reachable range), a human player's automatic and manual refreshes.
excludes: special game rules (HIGH_ROLLER, DITTO_PARTY, EVERYONE_IS_HERE, FAMILY_OUTING, ...)
shop-modifying items and dishes (Incense, Honey, Aqua Monica and other type items, Repeat Ball, Soothe Bell, ...)
synergy effects on the shop (Wild synergy bonus, Psychic/Unown shops, Falinks Brass)
fishing, Meltan magnet pull, gift shop, carousel/portal choices (only referenced where they explain the five units)
scope.note: Modifier paths were recorded as dependencies only.

rarityOdds.reachableLevels: 2..9 (a player starts at level 2 and the level cap is 9, see economy-leveling.json); rows 1 and 10 are declared but not reachable through ExperienceManager
rarityOdds.rowSumNote: Every row sums to 1; in 64-bit floating point the level-9 row sums to 0.9999999999999999. A seed in [0.9999999999999999, 1) would make the rarity loop run past the row (threshold becomes NaN) and the slot would fall back to MAGIKARP (rarity undefined -> error path, shop.ts:721-726); probability about 1e-16, noted for completeness only.
rarityOdds.mechanism: For each slot one seed s = Math.random() is compared with the cumulative row: rarity = the first band whose cumulative total >= s (while (s > threshold)); a seed exactly on a boundary belongs to the lower rarity. The player's level at the moment of the draw is used.
rarityOdds.whatLevelingChanges: Only the row used for the rarity roll (COMMON-only at level 2; UNCOMMON from 3, RARE from 4, EPIC from 5, ULTRA from 7). Shop size, pools and the unit-selection rule do not depend on level.
rarityOdds.executedChecks: probes/results/shop-probe.json: real pickPokemon with scripted Math.random at the middle of every non-zero band for levels 2-9 (all returned the expected rarity) and at the level-3 boundary (0.69 and 0.7 -> COMMON, 0.700001 and 0.9999 -> UNCOMMON)

order: 1. DITTO roll: chance 0.005 per slot at stage >= 6 (returns DITTO, no pool copy removed)
2. modifier branches (Unown by Psychic effects at slot 5, Falinks Brass) - not traced
3. type restriction roll: WILD-only with probability 0.06 at stage 0 or a PvE stage when no Wild synergy; item-based type attractors are modifiers
4. rarity roll from the level row
5. unit pick inside that rarity (HIGH_ROLLER / Repeat Ball special picks are modifiers)
slotSelection.unitPick: Candidates = every remaining copy of that rarity in the shared pool plus the player's own regional pool of that rarity (regional variants substituted when the player's regionalPokemons contains them), minus WILD-type units (unless WILD was requested), minus non-selected alt forms, minus lines the player already finalized. One entry is chosen uniformly, so a unit's chance within its rarity is its remaining eligible copies divided by all remaining eligible copies. The chosen copy is removed from the pool immediately.
slotSelection.configuredVsSpecific: The configured odds give the chance of a RARITY per slot only. The chance of a specific unit is not configured anywhere: it additionally depends on the remaining copies of every eligible unit of that rarity (other players' purchases and sells, offers currently displayed, own finalized lines, regional/additional pool contents, wild requests). No hit-chance formula is given because that state is not part of the rules.
slotSelection.sequentialDraws: The six slots are drawn one after another and each draw removes its copy, so later slots see the pool without the earlier offers.
unresolvedModifiers: Unown (Psychic) shops at slot 5, Falinks Brass, Soothe Bell, type items/dishes, Repeat Ball, HIGH_ROLLER, DITTO_PARTY, MYSTERY_BOX (Ditto becomes Meltan) - encountered, not traced

initialShared.rule: tier-1 units (stars 1, implemented, not additional, not regional) of COMMON..ULTRA rarity, PoolSize[rarity][2] copies each: COMMON 27, UNCOMMON 22, RARE 18, EPIC 14, ULTRA 10

pools.sharing: One Shop per game state, so the five pools are shared by all players; regional pools are per player.
pools.displayedButUnboughtOffer: A drawn offer is already removed from the pool while it is displayed. It returns only when the offers are released: at the next refresh (assignShop releases all current offers first), when the player removes it from the shop, or when the player dies. During an automatic refresh of a LOCKED shop (refillShop) the untouched offers stay displayed and stay out of the pool.
pools.bought: Buying writes DEFAULT into the slot; that copy is not returned. Executed accounting (real assignShop/releasePokemon, buy step reproduced): total 1802 -> 1796 after the first shop; a manual refresh keeps 1796 (offers returned, new ones drawn); buying one offer then refreshing leaves 1795.
pools.sold: Selling returns baseline copies by the unit's stars: 1 copy for a 1-star, 3 for a 2-star, 9 for a 3-star (executed: CHARMANDER 27 -> 28 -> 31 -> 40 using CHARMANDER / CHARMELEON / CHARIZARD). Regional units sold outside their region are not returned. Merged copies (evolution) are not returned until the evolved unit is sold.
pools.death: A dying human player's current offers and board/bench units are released to the shared pool (read, not executed).
pools.evolution: Evolving does not release anything (read: no release call on the evolution path was searched for beyond the buy/sell/death callers listed).
pools.additionalPicks: Units enter the shared pools at stages 5 (uncommon), 8 (rare) and 11 (epic): each human player gets 3 proposals; the chosen unit is added for everyone when picked, and leftover units of the stage are added directly; each is added once with PoolSize[rarity][stages-1] copies.
pools.regional: Per-player regional pools are refilled when the player's map changes (tier-1, non-variant regional units of the map, PoolSize[rarity][stages-1] copies each) and are included in that player's candidate list; variants substitute their base unit when the player's regionalPokemons list has them. How copies of variants are removed/returned was read but not verified (a variant's baseline may not be in the regional pool).

emptyPoolBehavior.rule: If no candidate remains for the drawn rarity (pool empty, or every remaining unit is filtered out) the slot becomes MAGIKARP. There is no re-roll of the rarity and no fall-back to another rarity. For a requested type: water -> MAGIKARP; other types retry once for the same rarity without the type.
emptyPoolBehavior.magikarpNote: MAGIKARP is a SPECIAL-rarity unit; getBuyPrice falls back to RarityCost[SPECIAL] = 0 (read). refillShop treats MAGIKARP slots as redrawable.

stage: Wild: 6 % per slot at stage 0 and PvE stages (shop for a PvE round is built after the stage counter increments, so the round about to be played counts)
Additional units: only after stages 5 / 8 / 11 have added them
Unique / Legendary: not part of the shop pools (portal choices at stages 10 / 20)
restrictions.additional: Additional units are absent from the initial pools (tier-1 filter) and enter the shared pools only through the additional-pick stages (or EVERYONE_IS_HERE).
restrictions.regional: Regional units are absent from the shared pools; they are in the player's own regional pool only while the map has the matching synergy (see evolution-context.md for the Psychic/Alolan Raichu example), and out-of-region regional units sold are not returned.

refreshAndLock.manualReroll: OnShopRerollCommand -> assignShop(manualRefresh = true): all current offers are released, six new ones drawn (cost and free rerolls: economy-leveling.json). Manual vs automatic differs only for the Unown-shop branch (modifier).
refreshAndLock.automatic: After every fight, after income and XP (so with the new level): unlocked shop -> assignShop(false); locked shop -> refillShop (only DEFAULT/MAGIKARP slots redrawn), then the lock is cleared.
refreshAndLock.lock: OnLockCommand toggles shopLocked; removing an offer also locks the shop.
refreshAndLock.initialShop: A human player's first shop is assigned when the player is created (stage 0, level 2).

CHARMANDER.conditions: COMMON, 1-star, not additional/regional/WILD-type, so it is in the shared COMMON pool from game start with 27 copies; it can be offered in any shop at any level (COMMON has non-zero probability at every reachable level 2-9) while copies remain and the player has not finalized the CHARMANDER line (e.g. a CHARIZARD on board or bench).

TOTODILE.conditions: RARE, 1-star, not additional/regional/WILD-type: in the shared RARE pool with 18 copies. RARE has probability 0 at levels 2-3, so it can only be offered from level 4 (rare 0.10) and only through a RARE roll, while copies remain and the TOTODILE line is not finalized by the player.

VESPIQUEN.conditions: Not in the normal shop: its rarity is UNIQUE and the normal draw only selects COMMON..ULTRA from the five pools (getPool returns undefined for UNIQUE); it is also a 3-star, outside the tier-1 filter. It is in UniquePool, offered through the stage-10 portal choice. Modifier paths (Repeat Ball, HIGH_ROLLER) can use pickSpecialPokemon(UNIQUE) and were not traced. This says nothing about other acquisition routes.

ARCEUS.conditions: Not in the normal shop: rarity LEGENDARY (no shop pool), 3-star. It is in LegendaryPool (stage-20 portal choice, where it can also replace a proposal with chance 1/400). Special picks of LEGENDARY by modifiers were not traced.

TYPE_NULL.conditions: Not in the normal shop: rarity LEGENDARY (no shop pool), 2-star; it is in LegendaryPool (stage-20 portal choice). Modifier special picks not traced.

executedChecks.distinction: Executed: pool construction, rarity bands, boundary semantics, release/assign/refill accounting, empty-pool fallback, Ditto and wild-chance branches (real code, stub player, scripted Math.random). Source tracing: callers (buy, sell, death, additional picks, regional pools, locking). Arithmetic: row sums, copy totals. Not executed: OnBuyPokemonCommand, selling and death commands, regional/additional paths.
